limitations: Separate instrumented observations, not a controlled elapsed-time comparison; use the matched uninstrumented build benchmark.
The amount of background sealing captured can differ because of cancellation and trace boundaries; raw fsync deltas are not normalized per artifact.
Syscall sums and operation counters overlap across threads and are not extra Cargo wall time.
Incomplete boundary calls are excluded from interval timing; zero lost samples and no observed I/O errors.
The kernel lacks FUSE request tracepoints; CPU sampling records user-space stacks.
One byte-equivalent pwrite64 entry at the same recorded timestamp was emitted twice; analysis counts it once and records the exact duplicate. Conflicting event pairs still fail validation.
